clue.text: Covert observation on copper linked to left-winger

parts.note: OBS is a standard abbreviation for observation
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a red is a socialist or communist, someone on the political left

explanation.surface: A spy's secret surveillance of a police officer who has links to a radical activist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' looks like a police officer, which suits the spying picture, but here it is the metal with symbol Cu.
explanation.definitionFit: Something covert is hidden from view, just as a thing that has been made dim or concealed is.

clue.text: Puff up aged grains after cooking

indicators.note: cooking the grains changes their form, so the letters of the two words are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Old grains swell up once they have been cooked, like rice in a pan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after cooking' rearranges the ten letters of AGED GRAINS.
explanation.definitionFit: To puff up something is to exaggerate or inflate it, to make it seem greater; a synonym.

clue.text: Sorting out cases of tetter, influenza and gangrene?

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outside, so each of the three words gives only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A doctor deals with patients suffering from a skin rash, flu and gangrene, deciding who goes first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cases of' takes the outer letters TR, IA and GE. Tetter is an old name for a skin disease such as eczema. The surface's medical cases are exactly what the process handles.
explanation.definitionFit: In hospitals, patients are sorted by urgency of treatment; that prioritising process is the medical term for sorting them out.

clue.text: Watch revival of Dracula?

definitions.meaning: a period of police surveillance of a place, watching for suspects
a vampire is killed by a stake through the heart, so pulling it back out would bring him back to life

explanation.surface: Keeping an eye out for a vampire returning from the dead.
explanation.definitionFit: Police surveillance of a building is a watch, kept by officers waiting outside it; the second reading is a pun on removing the stake.

clue.text: 'Licence to kill' discharged

parts.note: to let is to allow, so licence or permission gives LET
to off someone is slang for killing them

explanation.surface: A spy's licence to kill, as in James Bond, has been fired or used up.
explanation.walkthrough: The quoted phrase reads as one Bond idea but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A gun that is fired, or a prisoner released without penalty, has been discharged; a phrasal-verb synonym.

clue.text: Belgium's veteran forward

parts.note: B is the international vehicle code for Belgium
a veteran is old

explanation.surface: An experienced striker playing for the Belgian football team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forward' looks like a football position but is the adjective meaning brash.
explanation.definitionFit: A forward person is cheeky and presumptuous, which is a sense of brazen confidence; a synonym.

clue.text: Cure end of ham, slicing thin

indicators.note: the final letter cuts into the middle of the word for thin, as a knife slices

parts.note: reedy means slender or thin, like a reed

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Curing a ham, then cutting thin slices from the end of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cure' sounds like the butcher's process for ham, but it is the medical sense. 'slicing' puts M inside REEDY.
explanation.definitionFit: A medicine that heals a disease is a cure; the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Not having left famous house of ill-repute, ultimately winner of show

parts.note: big means important or famous, as in a big name

indicators.note: left abbreviates to L, and that letter is missing from the word for a bordello

parts.note: a brothel is a house of ill-repute

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the next word

explanation.surface: The winner of a reality show refuses to leave a notorious house; the show was famous for its house.
explanation.walkthrough: The house of ill-repute, a BROTHEL, loses L (left) to give BROTHE. The show is the reality TV programme in which contestants live in a house under cameras.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the title of a reality television programme, named after the watching leader in Orwell's 1984.

clue.text: Climax ends performances

parts.note: to come is slang for reaching sexual climax
to die is to end, as a fire or a sound does

explanation.surface: A cheeky line about a climax bringing performances to their finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Climax' and 'ends' read as nouns but both are verbs here.
explanation.definitionFit: Funny plays and shows are performances of a light, humorous kind; an example of the definition.

clue.text: Animal waste left in county, wasting energy

indicators.note: in places the left letter inside the shortened county
wasting means losing, so the energy letter is dropped from the county

parts.note: Surrey is an English county south of London
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Farm manure is left lying around in a rural county, squandering energy that could be used.
explanation.walkthrough: SURREY, a county south of London, loses E (energy) by 'wasting' to give SURRY; 'in' puts L inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid manure spread on fields is a watery mixture of animal waste, the farming sense of the word.

clue.text: Sex work can lead topless angel astray

indicators.note: going astray means wandering off course, so these letters are rearranged
topless takes away the first letter of the word after it

explanation.surface: Prostitution can lead a bare-chested angel into sin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless' removes A from ANGEL to give NGEL; 'astray' rearranges WORK CAN LEAD with NGEL.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical-legal phrase means sexual intercourse, so it is a formal synonym for sex.

clue.text: Aga perhaps controlled Georgia

parts.note: to run a business is to control it, past tense ran
GE is the international code for the country Georgia

explanation.surface: A cooker in a kitchen was operated from Georgia.
explanation.walkthrough: An Aga is a British brand of heavy cast-iron cooking stove, so 'perhaps' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: An Aga is an example of a kitchen cooking stove, which is the oven sense of the word.

clue.text: Give party member donations

parts.note: to offer is to give or present
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: An appeal for a political party member to make a donation.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the church collection, taken during a service.
explanation.definitionFit: The collection of money from a church congregation during a service is a gathering of donations.

clue.text: Old throne room perhaps raised above another seat of power

indicators.note: above means the first part sits over the second in a down answer
in a down clue raising a word means reading it from bottom to top

parts.note: the throne is slang for a toilet, so its room is a lavatory, shortened to lav
another throne room: offices is an old euphemism for the lavatory

explanation.surface: An ancient chamber with a throne, built above another place where power sat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'throne room' means a toilet, not a royal chamber. 'raised' turns LAV upwards to VAL; 'another' gives a second word for the toilet. The seat of power is the US President's office in the White House.
explanation.definitionFit: The US President's office in the White House is a metonym for presidential authority, so a seat of power.

clue.text: Backing singer maybe hired out for a small amount

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so this word reads from right to left

parts.note: a bird is an example of a singer, such as a songbird
a room that is let out is hired out, so let

explanation.surface: A backing vocalist is hired for a tiny fee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backing singer' looks like one phrase but 'Backing' turns BIRD into DRIB.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny quantity such as a trickle or dribble of liquid is a small amount.

clue.text: Was leaning — like famous old building?

definitions.meaning: a ship that tilted to one side heeled over or tipped
in Britain a building of historic importance is protected by being put on an official register

explanation.definitionFit: A ship that heeled over tilted; a protected historic building in Britain is on the official register of heritage buildings.

clue.text: Stray from street in need of protection

parts.note: way is a word for a road or street, as in Abbey Way
a ward is a child or person placed under someone's guardianship

explanation.surface: A lost animal off the street needs to be looked after.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stray' looks like a noun for a lost dog but is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: An unruly person who goes astray is disobedient and wilful; a synonym in the adjective sense.

clue.text: Sleeper comedian ends in orgasmatron getting fired up

parts.note: a wag is a joker or comedian

indicators.note: the ends of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: lit means set alight, fired up

explanation.surface: A sleepy comedian is aroused by the orgasm machine from Woody Allen's film Sleeper.
explanation.walkthrough: The Orgasmatron appears in the film Sleeper, so the surface is a joke. 'ends in' gives O and N.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway sleeping car on continental trains is a sleeper; the term comes from French.

clue.text: Look up when crossing street for fast car

indicators.note: crossing means going over, so the outer word spans across the street abbreviation
in a down clue up means the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: to regard is to look at

explanation.surface: Look up and down when crossing the road because of speeding traffic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Look up' reads as one phrasal verb but splits: 'up' turns the word for look into DRAGER, and 'crossing' has it span the street abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A car built for short sprint races on a straight track is a racing machine, a very fast car.

clue.text: Force to engage smooth criminals?

parts.note: to press clothes is to smooth them with an iron
a gang is a group of criminals

explanation.surface: Pressure is put on Michael Jackson's smooth criminals to take part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smooth Criminal' is a Michael Jackson song, hiding the split between the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To coerce someone into joining or serving is to force them to engage, as naval recruiters once did.

clue.text: Temple of Father and Holy Ghost, as Son omitted

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
in Christian belief the Holy Ghost is one person of God

indicators.note: omitted means left out, so the son letter is removed

explanation.surface: A church dedicated to the Holy Trinity, except the Son has been left out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Father', 'Holy Ghost' and 'Son' suggest the Trinity; only the Ghost is read as GOD. 'omitted' removes S from AS.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiered tower of Buddhist or Hindu worship in East Asia is a kind of temple.

clue.text: Oddly keen to tuck into grey, dry fruit

indicators.note: tucking into something puts it inside, so the picked letters go within the word for grey

parts.note: ashy means ash-coloured, grey

indicators.note: oddly picks the first, third and other odd-placed letters

explanation.surface: Eager to eat some grey dried fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tuck into' suggests eating but is the container. 'Oddly' takes K and E from KEEN.
explanation.definitionFit: The winged seed of the ash tree is a dry, papery fruit, botanically a samara.

clue.text: Member of orchestra gets abuse after dropping final note

indicators.note: dropping means losing, so the note at the end is taken off

parts.note: to violate is to abuse or desecrate
te is the last note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A musician in an orchestra is mocked after fluffing the last note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Member of orchestra' could be a player but is the instrument. 'final note' is not a last letter but te, the top note of the do-re-mi scale, which 'after dropping' strips away.
explanation.definitionFit: The instrument slightly larger than the violin is one section of a symphony orchestra; an example.

clue.text: Reeves has Minchin as fall guy

parts.note: Vic Reeves is a British comedian
Tim Minchin is an Australian comedian and songwriter

explanation.surface: One comedian makes another the butt of his act.
explanation.walkthrough: Both pieces are first names: Vic Reeves and Tim Minchin are comedians.
explanation.definitionFit: A fall guy is a scapegoat, someone who suffers for others; a synonym.

clue.text: Pay to stay in bondage gear not found in Fifty Shades of Grey?

definitions.meaning: money or benefits paid to an employee to discourage them from leaving

definitions.text: bondage gear not found in Fifty Shades of Grey?
definitions.meaning: restraints made of a yellow precious metal, not grey, would be out of place in that erotic novel

explanation.surface: A bonus to keep someone tied to a job, pictured as restraints in an erotic novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Financial incentives that make leaving a job costly tie the worker down; the second reading is literal bondage gear of the yellow metal.

clue.text: Drum up dirty look

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a reel is a drum or spool for winding cable or thread

explanation.surface: A sarcastic call to create a filthy look.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drum up' looks like a phrasal verb but 'up' turns REEL around.
explanation.definitionFit: A sly, lascivious or nasty sideways glance is a dirty look.

clue.text: See 9
REM and Icicle Works appearing after finale of Tenacious D?

indicators.note: the rearranged letters come after the single letter in the answer
the finale of a word is its last letter
works suggests reworking, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A list of bands: REM and The Icicle Works coming on after Tenacious D.
explanation.walkthrough: REM, Icicle Works and Tenacious D are all bands. 'Works' rearranges REM ICICLE; S comes from Tenacious.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital letter D looks like a half-round shape on a straight base; an example of the figure.
